visual.general_description: Two views of a pink 3D left atrial reconstruction.

visual.general_description: Combined bar and marker chart over 62 days of creatinine, creatinine clearance, urine production and dialysis.
visual.detailed_description: Combination chart on a white background with light horizontal gridlines. The x axis is labelled "Days" with categorical ticks 1 to 23 followed by 44 and 62 (so the last two ticks are not evenly spaced in time). The left y axis is labelled "Urine production 24h" with ticks 0 to 4000 in steps of 500; the right y axis is labelled "Creatinin clearenace 24h" (as printed) with ticks 0 to 60 in steps of 10 and no unit. The legend reads: Urine Production (ml/24h) as pale yellow bars, Creatinin clearence (24/h) as red squares, Creatinin (µmol/L) as blue circles, Dialysis (volume, L) as green circles. Blue creatinine circles carry printed values: 89 (day 1), 713 (day 3), 861 (day 4), 1282 (day 7), 1124 (day 8), 1004 (day 10), 1141 (day 11), 860 (day 12), 916 (day 13), 844 (day 14), 717 (day 15), 560 (day 16), 443 (day 17), 214 (day 23), 125 (day 44), 104 (day 62). Yellow bars appear on days 6 to 14 and day 23, rising from about 400 on day 6 to about 3800 on day 13 and 2800 on day 23. Red clearance squares occur on days 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 23, rising from near 1 to about 13 and then about 52. Four green dialysis circles are plotted on days 4, 5, 9 and 11 at roughly 1500, 1000, 1000 and 600 on the left axis scale.

visual.general_description: Schematic of catheter positioning relative to a pulmonary vein ostium in three views.
visual.detailed_description: Colour schematic on a white background with three bold teal column titles: "Anterior", "Lateral" and "Normal anatomy". Anterior (left): teal outlines of two vessel walls with the labels LSPV and LIPV, an orange wire-basket catheter outline with a black hub at the end of a teal shaft entering from the left, a vertical dotted teal line through the basket, and a narrow vertical bar shaded green at the top, red in the middle and white at the bottom. Lateral (centre): two vertical teal-outlined ellipses side by side and offset vertically, each overlaid by a five-petal orange catheter outline with a black hub; the left ellipse is shaded green above a red band with a white lower part, the right ellipse has a red band at the top, green in the lower half around its catheter and white edges; a faint dotted circle lies inside each ellipse. Normal anatomy (right): two navy-blue filled discs stacked vertically, each centred under a symmetric five-petal orange catheter outline with a black hub. There are no arrows, no legend explaining the green/red shading, no numbers and no patient identifiers.
